description: What it does Nano Banana Lite is a free online AI image generator powered by Google's Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite model. Type a prompt, get a finished image in under 2 seconds — no signup, no watermark, no queue. Key benefits - Ultra-fast generation — images ready in ~1 second - 100% free daily credits, no account required - Accurate text rendering inside generated images - Multilingual prompt support (18 languages) - Style presets for quick creative exploration - Commercial use allowed on all outputs
